lines: Probe concealment, as the old books say —
One Lord, two orders, bound and free, holds sway.
sanskrit_cite: tirobhāvasvarūpaṃ tu kathyamānaṃ vivicyatām | svabhāvāt parameśāno niyatyaniyatikramam

lines: He touches all, and shining, claims the free —
yet stoops to sow and reap, as law could be.
sanskrit_cite: spṛśanprakāśate yena tataḥ svacchanda ucyate | niyatiṃ karmaphalayorāśrityaiṣa maheśvaraḥ

lines: Three works he weaves between the worlds each turn,
then burns the loom at the aeons' yearn.
sanskrit_cite: sṛṣṭisaṃsthitisaṃhārānvidhatte@vāntarasthitīn | mahāsarge punaḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhārānantyaśālini

lines: One Lord drops law, yet form he will not shed;
between, unforced, the stillness lies ahead.
sanskrit_cite: ekaḥ sa devo viśvātmā niyatityāgataḥ prabhuḥ | avāntare yā ca sṛṣṭiḥ sthitiścātrāpyayantritam

lines: Form he keeps, though law he leaves behind —
then veils himself, by rule of covered mind.
sanskrit_cite: nojjhatyeṣa vapustyaktaniyatiśca sthito@tra tat | niyatyaiva yadā caiṣa svarūpācchādanakramāt

lines: Taste woe, and karma's ledger comes alive;
drop the karmic rein, and sorrows thrive.
sanskrit_cite: bhuṅkte duḥkhavimohādi tadā karmaphalakramaḥ | tyaktvā tu niyamaṃ kārmaṃ duḥkhamohaparītatām

lines: He'd shine, yet sits in seeming night —
freedom's play in borrowed plight.
sanskrit_cite: bibhāsayiṣurāste@yaṃ tirodhāne@napekṣakaḥ | yathā prakāśasvātantryāt pratibuddho@pyabuddhavat

lines: Uncrossed yet crossing, hating as he plays
the fool — a king in beggar's days.
sanskrit_cite: āste tadvadanuttīrṇo@pyuttīrṇa iva ceṣṭate | yathā ca buddhastāṃ mūḍhaceṣṭāṃ kurvannapi dviṣan

lines: The moth beats round the masters' flame and falls;
the schoolmen heard such midnight calls.
sanskrit_cite: hṛdyāste mūḍha evaṃ hi prabuddhānāṃ viceṣṭitam | śrīvidyādhipatiścāha mānastotre tadīdṛśam

lines: Sun-sworn scholars, sunk in doubt's eclipse —
can lotus shut where sunlight drips?
sanskrit_cite: ye yauṣmāke śāsanamārge kṛtadīkṣāḥ saṃgacchanto mohavaśādvipratipattim | nūnaṃ teṣā nāsti bhavadbhānuniyogaḥ saṅkocaḥ kiṃ sūryakaraistāmarasānām

lines: Book-learned climbers, slipped from grace's height,
light lamps of lies — cold phosphor light.
sanskrit_cite: jñātajñeyā dhātṛpadasthā api santo ye tvanmārgātkāpathagāste@pi na samyaka | prāyasteṣāṃ laiṅgikabuddhyādisamuttho mithyābodhaḥ sarpavasādīpajakalpaḥ

lines: Lead once pierced stays copper evermore —
unnipped nectar leaves the thirsting sore.
sanskrit_cite: yasmādviddhaṃ sūtakamukhyena nu tāmraṃ tadyadbhūyaḥ svāṃ prakṛtiṃ no samupeyāt | no taiḥ pītaṃ bhūtalasaṃsthairamṛtaṃ tadyeṣāṃ tṛṭkṣudduḥkhavibādhāḥ punarasmin

lines: Then wakes the rite, and doubt's the inward pyre —
hatred lit, the self's on fire.
sanskrit_cite: tataḥ prabuddhaceṣṭāsau mantracaryārcanādikā | dveṣeddhāntardahatyenaṃ dāhaḥ śaṅkaiva sā yataḥ

lines: No deed of old explains this shrouded hour —
what act? what law with equal power?
sanskrit_cite: na cāsya karmamahimā tādṛgyenetthamāsta saḥ | kiṃ hi tatkarma kasmādvā pūrveṇātra samo vidhiḥ

lines: Lord-willed, to sorrow's endless sea he's bound —
a vessel for the timeless wound.
sanskrit_cite: tasmātsā parameśecchā yayāyaṃ mohitastathā | anantakālasaṃvedyaduḥkhapātratvamīhate

lines: Yet varied wills deal varied pain's degree —
soon or late, both here and free.
sanskrit_cite: tatrāpi cecchāvaicitryādihāmutrobhayātmakaḥ | duḥkhasyāpi vibhedo@sti ciraśaighryakṛtastathā

lines: Time, Lust, and Blind, and Lankā's kin below —
all drink concealment's cup of woe.
sanskrit_cite: kālakāmāndhakādīnāṃ paulastyapuravāsinām | tathānyeṣāṃ tirobhāvastāvadduḥkho hyamutra ca

lines: Break the bond, and darkness wears thy face —
so saith the Cave of Blissful Grace.
sanskrit_cite: anyo@pi ca tirobhāvaḥ samayollaṅghanātmakaḥ | yaduktaṃ parameśena śrīmadānandagahvare

lines: A hundred years a carrion crow shall cry
who breaks the vow — by shades, or high.
sanskrit_cite: samayollaṅghanāddevi kravyādatvaṃ śataṃ samāḥ | tatrāpi mandatīvrādibhedādbahuvidhaḥ kramaḥ

lines: Yet freedom's Lord leaves open hunger's door —
by self or friend, grace visits more.
sanskrit_cite: svātantryācca maheśasya tirobhūto@pyasau svayam | paradvāreṇa vābhyeti bhūyo@nugrahamapyalam

lines: Penance paved, the rites restored anew —
Śiva-natured, washed and true.
sanskrit_cite: bhūyo@nugrahataḥ prāyaścittādyācaraṇe sati | anusāreṇa dīkṣādau kṛte syācchivatāmayaḥ

lines: Death seals no doors where kin implore —
grace descends to ocean's floor.
sanskrit_cite: tirobhūtaḥ paretāsurapi bandhusuhṛdgurūn | ālambya śaktipātena dīkṣādyairanugṛhyate

lines: Slow or swift, the Power descends the same —
and lifts the soul by Śiva's name.
sanskrit_cite: tatrāpi kālaśīghratvaciratvādivibhedatām | tathaiti śaktipāto@sau yenāyāti śivātmatām

lines: Fivefold the doing, deity the doer —
knowing makes the mortal truer.
sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ sṛṣṭisthitidhvaṃsatirobhāvamanugrahaḥ | iti pañcasu kartṛtvaṃ śivatvaṃ saṃvidātmanaḥ

lines: Five fires lit, the yogin burns alway
with prayer and praise at close of day.
sanskrit_cite: pañcakṛtyasvatantratvasaṃpūrṇasvātmamāninaḥ | yogino@rcājapadhyānayogāḥ saṃsyuḥ sadoditāḥ

lines: No jugglers' joys shall turn his head —
even Brahman's bliss is bondage-bread.
sanskrit_cite: aindrajālikavṛttānte na rajyeta kadācana | sādāśivo@pi yo bhogo bandhaḥ so@pyucitātmanām

lines: To know is Śiva; to know is free —
no potter's wheel shall Master be.
sanskrit_cite: jñātṛtvameva śivatā svātantryaṃ tadihocyate | kulālavattu kartṛtvaṃ na mukhyaṃ tadadhiṣṭhiteḥ

lines: 'I am That' needs no defense; the sneer —
'why not the world?' — let doubters hear.
sanskrit_cite: iti jñātvā grahītavyā naiva jātvapi khaṇḍanā | śivo@haṃ cenmadicchānuvarti kiṃ na jagattviti

lines: 'Obey me,' the I within shall say —
bodies build and melt away.
sanskrit_cite: mamecchāmanuvartantāmityatrāhaṃvidi sphuret | śivo vā parameśāno dehādiratha nirmitaḥ

lines: Whose is this frame by thee once made?
What speech can lend thy shade?
sanskrit_cite: śivasya tāvadastyetaddehastveṣa tathā tvayā | kṛtaḥ kānyā dehatāsya tatkiṃ syādvācyatāpadam

lines: Wind-tossed breathers plow the air —
their toil the Yogin's snare.
sanskrit_cite: uktaṃ ca siddhasantānaśrīmadūrmimahākule | pavanabhramaṇaprāṇavikṣepādikṛtaśramāḥ

lines: Duped in waking, duped in dream —
they call departure's gleam supreme.
sanskrit_cite: kuhakādiṣu ye bhrāntāste bhrāntāḥ parame pade | sarvatra bahumānena yāpyutkrāntirvimuktaye

lines: Where leaves the All, if All is here?
Tell, O leaver, far or near!
sanskrit_cite: proktā sā sāraśāstreṣu bhogopāyatayoditā | yadi sarvagatā devo vadotkramya kva yāsyati

lines: Bound the Boundless? Then a pot is he;
yet partial rites for passing free.
sanskrit_cite: athāsarvagatastarhi ghaṭatulyastadā bhavet | utkrāntividhiyogo@yamekadeśena kathyate

lines: No seams in Self — where slips the soul?
Cliff, flood, and flame exact no toll.
sanskrit_cite: niraṃśe śivatattve tu kathamutkrāntisaṃgatiḥ | yathā dharādau vāyvante bhṛgvambvagnyupavāsakaiḥ

lines: Link thyself to void above,
nor tear the soul for farther love.
sanskrit_cite: ātmano yojanaṃ vyomni tadvadutkrāntivartanā | tasmānnotkramayejjīvaṃ paratattvasamīhayā

lines: The old book names departure's art
not freedom's door, but hunger's mart.
sanskrit_cite: śrīpūrvaśāstre tūktaṃ yadutkrānterlakṣaṇaṃ na tat | muktyupāyatayā kiṃtu bhogahānyai tathaiṣaṇāt

lines: Ripe in prayer, by grace grown free,
leave the husk, if husk must be.
sanskrit_cite: japadhyānādisaṃsiddhaḥ svātantryācchaktipātataḥ | bhogaṃ prati viraktaśceditthaṃ dehaṃ tyajediti

lines: Bhīṣma waited, sated, still —
life ebbs out by sovereign will.
sanskrit_cite: svacchandamṛtyorapi yad bhīṣmādeḥ śrūyate kila | bhogavairasyasaṃprāptau jīvitāntopasarpaṇam

lines: Yoga-bought bodies never die
but by the book's own lullaby.
sanskrit_cite: yogamantrāmṛtadravyavarādyaiḥ siddhibhāktanuḥ | hātuṃ nahyanyathā śakyā vinoktakramayogataḥ

lines: Call all pleasure foul and flee —
so speaks the Goddess's decree.
sanskrit_cite: uktaṃ ca mālinītantre parameśena tādṛśam | sarvamapyathavā bhogaṃ manyamāno virūpakam

lines: All miss the Inward ever near;
be free in field and frontier.
sanskrit_cite: ityādi vadatā sarvairalakṣyāntaḥsatattvakam | evaṃ sṛṣṭyādikartavyasvasvātantryopadeśanam

lines: Chief baptism, Śiva-sent and sealed,
in Night's own book revealed.
sanskrit_cite: yatsaiva mukhyadīkṣā syācchiṣyasya śivadāyinī | uktaṃ śrīniśicāre ca bhairavīyeṇa tejasā

lines: Thoughtless eyes the All inhere;
thought-bound wait the dying year.
sanskrit_cite: vyāptaṃ viśvaṃ prapaśyanti vikalpojjhitacetasaḥ | vikalpayuktacittastu piṇḍapātācchivaṃ vrajet

lines: No outer font can free the mind —
thought-free, freedom now you find.
sanskrit_cite: bāhyadīkṣādiyogena caryāsamayakalpanaiḥ | avikalpastathādyaiva jīvanmukto na saṃśayaḥ

lines: Burnt world's roots, yet sparks take wing —
and blaze as suns undying.
sanskrit_cite: saṃsārajīrṇatarumūlakalāpakalpasaṃkalpasāntaratayā paramārthavahneḥ | syurvisphuliṅgakaṇikā api cettadante dedīpyate vimalabodhahutāśarāśiḥ

lines: Thus the gate of grace stands wide.
sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ dīkṣopakramo@yaṃ darśitaḥ śāstrasaṃmataḥ
